scope: One Swiss appliance study, three product categories; author-English textual reconstruction.

cold_start.selection_basis: User-approved probability/background hypotheses and fixed pilot prompt, not target-development outcomes. No target answers in model context.
cold_start.argmax_diagnostic: Use same rich probability vectors; report tied maxima, deterministic first-index argmax and position limitation. No extra call.

calibrated.main: development-selected temperature and convex blend of rich probability output and rich statistical baseline
calibrated.selection: Training fits statistical parameters; development selects regularization and probability calibration; test scored once after all selections freeze. Weight zero means statistics-only, not AI improvement.

sample_rationale: Use all 683 held-out people, four tasks each. No claim that this guarantees power for small effects.
primary_scoring: Person-averaged multiclass Brier, 2000 paired respondent bootstraps by product category. Relative improvement >=2% and positive 95% interval. Exact card population distributions not a primary metric because cards are sparse.
shuffle_policy: Within product, split, exact age and education; swap income/ideology blocks. Full sample plus 365 actual-content-changed test people; not a causal personality effect.
leakage: Inputs whitelist only; no targets, weights or identifiers transmitted. Test outcomes are not used to alter model or configuration.
limitations: Author-English text rather than original individual language and graphics.
No opt-out in original forced choice.
One study only; independent replication and synthetic population remain required.
